## Current execution policy — 6 September 2026

The maintainer is the sole human decision-maker; all other repository review opinions are supplied by an explicitly identified agent panel.

Use separate source/provenance, scientific/estimand, numerical, domain/ethics and API/governance agent roles, followed by orchestrator synthesis and the sole maintainer decision. This replaces two-human, conflict-free-human and independent-human-chair requirements for repository review. Preserve the selected proposed generic-kernel exclusion and narrower non-authorizing research. Refresh the candidate/source packet; re-review the three implemented remediation items; resolve all 19 finding dispositions, including Critical H8D-DS-03, with evidence and dissent. Role separation does not by itself prove independent evidence or resolve findings. The current request authorizes the review route, not an invented scientific or study authorization.

This section supersedes conflicting repository reviewer-recruitment requirements below. Earlier records remain historical evidence; unchecked scientific findings and destination outcomes are not marked complete by this policy change.

---

Conduct the SR4 primary-source and estimand review for harms caused by the sampling process itself.

Declare the sampling action, harm distribution, catastrophic/absorbing outcomes, risk criterion/constraints, net information value including acquisition risk, zero-harm reduction to ordinary EVSI/ENBS, enumerable counterexamples and sensitivity analysis. This is not an existing #570 runtime capability and is not a #595 VoC alias.

### Current boundary

VOP PR #71 synchronized canonical C18/M32 planning as `e0ff1d2ce3361d52ee22bb01e105b92653ed606c`. VOIAGE PR #855 delivered the repository-owned scope as `62d22743b1547266bd554b215f957934bf577234` after 60 successful checks, four governed skips, one neutral result and zero unresolved review threads. The automated advisory panel found zero unresolved Critical/High issues on exact semantic commit `eeb50c303246b4865c4a0b92e4669c92dd8196ea`. VOIAGE PR #861 completed H8-A as `2367074d4b8ea14590746286649d9afb8ebebaef`, selecting only the generic automatic-scalar or study-authorizing kernel as the review target for a proposed exclusion while preserving constrained/vector candidate research.

VOIAGE PR #862 completed H8-C as `efc62025ba2076de0e77f70724e9e5ca272e231a` after 38 successful checks, three governed skips, one neutral CodeQL result and zero unresolved review threads, freezing the candidate-bound preparation packet without satisfying independent review or human confirmation.

VOIAGE PR #863 completed only the automated H8-D-A/H8-E-A preparation as `0c3f4314368693a07d0f9f6996e123a1d20ef208` after 38 successful checks, three governed skips, one neutral summary and zero unresolved review threads. Its five role-shaped reports and separate synthesis retain 19 pending findings (one Critical, 15 High and three Medium), disqualifying estimator-assurance independence and blocked independent source review.

Owner-authored #873 comment 5166647873 now selects option 1: independently review the proposed generic-kernel `reviewed_exclusion` while preserving narrower non-authorizing research. Issue #873 and Project 28 read back Closed/Done/Resolved/Verified/Clean. Native child #876 remains Open/In Progress/Blocked/Human/Critical/Clean for independent source, eligible-reviewer and replacement-packet prerequisites.

Those records do not satisfy #853/H8, authorize a sampling-harm runtime, or authorize a real study. The amended H8-A–H8-H plan requires evidence-contract hardening, a narrow candidate or reviewed exclusion, a fresh #850-specific packet, independent role reports, separate orchestrator synthesis, two distinct scientific and domain/ethics humans, conditional independent-chair adjudication, a separate maintainer decision and fail-closed governance readback. Parity, promotion, release, publication, registry acceptance and closure remain distinct gates.
<!-- conductor-managed:end -->

### Required sequence

- [x] H8-A — select only the generic automatic-scalar or study-authorizing kernel as the review target for a proposed `reviewed_exclusion`; no completed exclusion or human confirmation is claimed, and parameterized constrained/vector candidate research remains eligible for future review.
- [x] H8-B — harden typed Git OIDs, canonical SHA-256 hashing, tree-byte verification, complete finding closure, role separation, authenticated receipts, expiry/supersession and narrow delta rules.
- [x] H8-C — freeze a clean #850/#853-specific packet with sources, claims, capability boundary, estimator thresholds, issue/Project snapshot and prior findings.
- [x] H8-D-A — generate five automated role-shaped challenge reports with explicit non-human, non-eligible authority boundaries; retain all findings and conflicts.
- [x] H8-D-D — materialize the fail-closed human commissioning preflight and role-specific handoff under #870; this preparation does not select the candidate, qualify a reviewer, disposition a finding or satisfy H8-D.
- [x] H8-D-E — owner-authored #873 comment 5166647873 selects option 1: independently review the proposed generic-kernel `reviewed_exclusion` while preserving narrower non-authorizing research; #873 and Project 28 read back Closed/Done/Resolved/Verified/Clean, and only candidate selection advances.
- [ ] H8-D-F — under #876 obtain independent source retrieval, rights/applicability review, eligible conflict-free human assignments and a replacement packet; repository preparation or automated agents cannot satisfy this Human/Critical gate.
- [ ] H8-D — obtain qualified independent human role/domain review after eligibility and conflict screening.
- [x] H8-E-A — generate a separate automated non-deciding synthesis of the role-shaped reports, dissent, options, contingencies, rationale and recommendation.
- [ ] H8-E — obtain synthesis that is eligible to consume the qualified H8-D human review and preserve dissent.
- [ ] H8-F — disposition every finding and repeat affected roles against a fresh packet after substantive remediation; use a chair for dispute, dissent or reviewer remediation.
- [ ] H8-G — obtain signed candidate-bound confirmation from two distinct humans, one scientific and one domain/ethics qualified, then a separate maintainer product decision.
- [ ] H8-H — synchronize and read back this issue, #850, Project 28, roadmap, canonical projections and Conductor; partial synchronization is `Conflict` and prohibits closure.

### Decision boundary

Subagents and the orchestrator provide challenge and synthesis evidence only. The sole maintainer may merge ordinary PRs without another code reviewer and separately decide whether to retain, implement, promote, release or close. The maintainer cannot self-satisfy independent scientific/domain/ethics review or real-study authorization. Scientific acceptability does not satisfy runtime, real-study, parity, promotion, release, publication, registry or closure gates.
